name: B10-0545/2025 (Verts/ALE) – EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a peace in Ukraine that is fair to Ukraine, not dictated by the United States and Russia. It says a leaked United States–Russia plan would amount to Ukraine surrendering, and it rejects limits on Ukraine's army or on which alliances Ukraine may join. It asks European countries to take more responsibility for their own security, to keep sanctions on Russia, and to stop buying Russian fossil fuels. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament states its position and demands.
- **Who it affects:** European Union governments, Ukraine, Russia and the United States.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to European Union institutions and member state governments; no vote or deadline is set here.
